prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a rear-end collision. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1013; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The damage is mostly in line with the described impact.
- Two similar charges on the same day are being checked.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The rear bumper cover, trunk lid, and right taillamp assembly show crushing and tearing consistent with the reported rear-end impact, and the pattern of damage lines up with the described collision. Repair labor hours are reasonable for the scope of work outlined. No prior damage to the vehicle has come to light during inspection. Two similar line-item charges entered on the same day are currently being verified against the parts invoices before the estimate is finalized. Repair plan: replace the bumper cover, trunk lid, and taillamp, refinish affected panels, and recheck the rear body alignment after parts are fitted.
